headline: Load spike still red — one easy class today, keep it honestly easy this time.
body_state: Verdict is red, driven by load: acute:chronic ratio climbed to 1.83 (up from 1.52 yesterday) — above the 1.5 line tied to 2–4x injury risk next week. Sleep debt is still ~22h over 14 days, last night 6.2h (sleep score 56), and HRV dipped to 38ms overnight (still Balanced band) from 44ms Tuesday. Body battery is 39 this morning. TSB sits at -14.19 on CTL 33.41 — technically inside the -5…-30 "productive" band, which is why the composite readiness reads 59.5 (moderate) even as the load-spike flag stays red. Garmin's own single-day training-readiness score is lower still, 35, and training status reads Unproductive. Trust the load-spike flag over the single-day number today.
session: Only one session on the calendar today: the 45min Un1t class, no run stacked alongside it — good, that's the first day in a week without a same-day double. Your last two Un1t sessions (Mon and Tue) both ran ~77% Zone 3/4 (avg HR 141, RPE 8 and unrated) — hard efforts, not recovery. With ACWR at 1.83 and battery at 39, today is the day to actually cap it: hold under ~133bpm (Zone 2) where you can, and don't chase the class's pace cues if HR climbs into the 150s. Rate the RPE afterward so it's not another unrated session in the load series.
recent: Sun's planned easy+strides run didn't happen; instead you rode 28.84km outdoors (unrated, still invisible to load). Mon's Un1t class ran hard (44.7min, HR141, RPE8, 76.7% Zone3/4). Tue you ran the 5.2km easy run cleanly on paper (4:32/km, HR130, green vs plan) but then stacked an unplanned evening Un1t Hyrox session on top anyway (42.9min, HR141, 77% Zone3/4) — the exact same-day double flagged in yesterday's brief as the ACWR driver, and it's why the ratio moved from 1.52 to 1.83 instead of coming down. Grey-zone training (17.6% easy vs 80% target) remains limiter #1 for a fourth straight review.
focus: Sleep first — ~60min earlier tonight; still the named driver behind the red readiness composite.
One session today, kept in Zone 2 — don't repeat Mon/Tue's pattern of turning Un1t into a hard, unrated hit.
Rate Mon's bike ride and this week's Un1t sessions — they're currently unrated and invisible to load, masking how close ACWR really is to the risk line.
